name: Progress M-54
about: Progress M-54 (2005-035A), a crewed vehicle (Progress M), launched 2005 Sep  8. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2005 Sep 16), held fixed
docked to S26400; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
